'''Travecao Govan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], she was part of [[Satele Shan]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] [[Yavin Coalition]] along with forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] under [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Marr]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Travecao Govan appears as a Jedi Knight gear vendor in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]]. She was later removed during a gear system restructuring.
